raised side portions plus separate hypothesized lower centre crossing; verify height and opening onsite
rectangular slab grid and surface-transition boundaries

visible_features.confidence: high feature, exact map position estimated
visible_features.simulation: round concrete columns, canopy strip and pink facade cue
four narrow parallel metal guide rails and dot-pattern warning pad
long edge drain and transverse crossing grates
wet-zone mask and optional lower-speed/traction scenario
separate campus-store pavilion landmark beside the cobbled lane

navigation_policy.cobblestone: reduce speed and use conservative clearance
navigation_policy.threshold: do not assume it is traversable until height and wheel clearance are verified
navigation_policy.stairs: hard no-go for the small wheeled rover; prefer a verified ramp
navigation_policy.wet_surfaces: lower speed; friction coefficients are scenario parameters, not measured
navigation_policy.finish: latch FINISHED and hold both drive commands at zero at the configured Block H approach

limitations: The public campus plan and operator photos/video are not metric survey data. Coordinates, dimensions, grades, and route positions are estimates.
The lower centre threshold crossing is a simulation hypothesis; the photo only establishes a transverse raised edge.
Small tactile rails, warning studs, flush covers, and thin drain slots may not be reliably detected by the 17 cm-high LiDAR.
Do not use this layer for real-world autonomous navigation until route, ramp grade, threshold height, entrances, drainage and obstacles are verified onsite.
